title: Simple Cantaloupe Smoothie
description: This cantaloupe smoothie recipe uses vanilla yogurt blended with fresh cantaloupe and orange juice for a creamy and delicious way to start your day.
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla yogurt (such as Dannon® Light and Fit®)
4 ice cubes, crushed, or as needed
instructions: Process yogurt, orange juice, cantaloupe, and ice cubes in a blender until smooth, about 30 seconds.
author: [{'@type': 'Person', 'name': 'Beth'}]

featured_tweaks.text: Used vanilla Greek yogurt (what I had on hand)t, added a few more ice cubes and ended up with a really creamy breakfast smoothie. I had a perfectly ripe cantaloupe and just eyeballed the amount, adding a more than 1/2 cup I'd say, but the OJ still slightly overpowered the cantaloupe flavor. Didn't really matter that much, as it was perfectly sweet, and I enjoyed it.
